blocks.text: Nervous system ki bimariyan yun ginti jati hain: vascular (dimagh aur spinal cord ki khoon ki nalyan), infectious (jaraseemi), structural (jismani banawat ka nuqsan), functional (koi nazar aane wali banawati wajah nahi) aur degenerative (nerve cells ka barhta hua zawal). Agle topics har aik ki aik misal bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Asabi bimariyon ki paanch qismein batayein.
blocks.explanation: Vascular, infectious, structural, functional aur degenerative.

items: Paanch qismein: vascular, infectious, structural, functional, degenerative.
